decisive_items: Viral cytopathic inclusions (highlighted by CMV immunostain)
Multiple episodes of bright red blood per rectum
response.rationale: CMV colitis is confirmed by viral inclusions on immunostain with active colitis and ulceration; R7 is a broader infection label lacking colitis specificity. Other candidates lack or contradict the definitive viral evidence.

rejected.why: Only describes bleeding symptom, not a specific diagnosis.
No radiation history; contradicts viral inclusions.
IBD lacks viral inclusions and diarrhea is post-bowel regimen.
Ischemic colitis contradicted by absence of pain and viral inclusions.
Diverticulitis contradicted by rectal location, no pain, and viral inclusions.
